rules.message: The lookup needs a hint slot: data-hx-target must resolve to an element (e.g. #postal-result).
Guard the trigger on a complete value — change[target.value.length==8] — or every keystroke becomes a request.
The lookup must send the postal value: data-hx-include="this" on the input.
Give the postal input inputmode="numeric" and a placeholder mirroring the mask (123-4567).
Mirror the mask for no-JS validation: pattern="\d{3}-\d{4}" on the postal input.
